"""E0-10: qualify the actual gate-scoped profile without changing frozen sources."""
import ast
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import subprocess
import time

ROOT=Path('/tmp/stele-post278-frontier')
OUT=Path('/tmp/stele-lookup-scoped-53eebe1')
PAIR=Path('/tmp/stele-lookup-profile-f2dfd91')
HEAD='53eebe1acd6363395367652ecf6a672e1e19db15'
TREE='5b95fbe8bd3c98891a27b5152ae56585d448af71'
def sha(p):
 with p.open('rb') as f: return hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
def git(*a): return subprocess.check_output(['git',*a],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
def clean():
 assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==HEAD and git('rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}')==TREE
 assert not git('status','--porcelain')
 assert not git('diff','f2dfd917baf00b8419dbf264c5f3cbdafa052d46','HEAD','--',
  'crates','tests/negative-controls','Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','rust-toolchain.toml','.cargo')
clean()
assert sha(PAIR/'results.json')=='baed2ad60f12d25053485139db32572a87775b1cf860a7c7f321e8f476c91fbf'
pair=json.loads((PAIR/'results.json').read_bytes())
assert pair['complete'] and pair['exact_native_output_equal'] and pair['safety_and_features_equal']
tree=ast.parse((ROOT/'scripts/gates/check.py').read_text())
assignments=[n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Assign)
 and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='lookup_env' for t in n.targets)]
assert len(assignments)==1
expr=assignments[0].value
assert isinstance(expr,ast.Call) and isinstance(expr.func,ast.Name) and expr.func.id=='dict'
assert len(expr.args)==1 and ast.dump(expr.args[0])==ast.dump(ast.parse('os.environ',mode='eval').body)
settings={k.arg:ast.literal_eval(k.value) for k in expr.keywords}
assert settings=={'CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_OPT_LEVEL':'2','CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG_ASSERTIONS':'true',
 'CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_OVERFLOW_CHECKS':'true'}
unexpected=[k for k,v in os.environ.items() if v and (k.startswith('CARGO_PROFILE_') or k in
 {'RUSTFLAGS','CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS','CARGO_BUILD_RUSTFLAGS','RUSTC_WRAPPER',
  'RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER','RUSTC','CARGO_BUILD_TARGET','CARGO_TARGET_DIR'})]
assert not unexpected,('Unexpected compiler override names',unexpected)
OUT.mkdir(); target=OUT/'target';target.mkdir()
env_values=dict(settings,CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(target),CARGO_TERM_COLOR='never')
env=dict(os.environ,**env_values)
data=dict(task='E0-10',head=HEAD,tree=TREE,driver_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),
 source_sha256={p:sha(ROOT/p) for p in ['scripts/gates/check.py','scripts/tests/test_field_source_gate.py',
  'tests/negative-controls/lookup_corpus.py','tests/negative-controls/fixtures/integer-linear/manifest.json']},
 frozen_source_parity='All crates, control/oracle sources, Cargo inputs and toolchain equal f2dfd917baf00b8419dbf264c5f3cbdafa052d46.',
 pair_receipt_sha256=sha(PAIR/'results.json'),env=env_values,profile='dev with gate-scoped checked optimisation',
 request_path=str(PAIR/'requests.jsonl'),request_sha256=sha(PAIR/'requests.jsonl'),
 rustc=subprocess.check_output(['rustc','--version','--verbose'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),
 cargo=subprocess.check_output(['cargo','--version'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),host=platform.platform(),
 cpu=subprocess.check_output(['sysctl','-n','machdep.cpu.brand_string'],text=True).strip(),complete=False)
assert data['request_sha256']==pair['request_sha256']
assert data['rustc']==pair['rustc'] and data['cargo']==pair['cargo'] and data['host']==pair['host']
def save(): (OUT/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
def run(name,args,request=None):
 out,err=OUT/(name+'.stdout'),OUT/(name+'.stderr')
 record=dict(argv=args,cwd=str(ROOT),started_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
  load_before=[str(v) for v in os.getloadavg()])
 print(json.dumps({'start':name}),flush=True);start=time.monotonic_ns()
 with out.open('xb') as stdout,err.open('xb') as stderr:
  result=subprocess.run(args,cwd=ROOT,env=env,input=request,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr)
 record.update(exit_code=result.returncode,wall_ns=time.monotonic_ns()-start,
  ended_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),load_after=[str(v) for v in os.getloadavg()],
  stdout=str(out),stdout_sha256=sha(out),stdout_bytes=out.stat().st_size,
  stderr=str(err),stderr_sha256=sha(err),stderr_bytes=err.stat().st_size)
 print(json.dumps({'finish':name,'exit_code':result.returncode,'wall_ns':record['wall_ns']}),flush=True)
 return record
save()
data['build']=run('build',['cargo','build','--profile','dev','-p','stele-negative-controls',
 '--example','lookup_corpus','--locked','--offline','--verbose','--message-format=json'])
save();assert data['build']['exit_code']==0
messages=[json.loads(line) for line in Path(data['build']['stdout']).read_bytes().splitlines()]
assert any(m['reason']=='build-finished' and m['success'] for m in messages)
artifacts=[m for m in messages if m['reason']=='compiler-artifact']
selected=[m for m in artifacts if m['target']['name']=='lookup_corpus' and m['target']['kind']==['example'] and m['executable']]
assert len(selected)==1
artifact=selected[0];executable=Path(artifact['executable']).resolve()
assert executable.is_relative_to(target.resolve()) and executable.is_file()
runtime=[m for m in artifacts if m['target']['name'].startswith('stele_') or m['target']['name']=='lookup_corpus']
for m in runtime:
 p=m['profile'];assert p['opt_level']=='2' and p['debug_assertions'] and p['overflow_checks'] and not p['test']
features={m['target']['name']:sorted(m['features']) for m in runtime}
expected={m['name']:sorted(m['features']) for m in pair['configurations'][1]['runtime_artifacts']}
assert features==expected and len(features)==len(runtime)
data.update(artifact=artifact,executable_sha256=sha(executable),runtime_artifacts=[
 dict(name=m['target']['name'],features=m['features'],profile=m['profile']) for m in runtime])
save();request=(PAIR/'requests.jsonl').read_bytes()
data['corpus']=run('corpus',[str(executable)],request)
save();assert data['corpus']['exit_code']==0 and not Path(data['corpus']['stderr']).read_bytes()
actual=Path(data['corpus']['stdout']);expected=Path(pair['configurations'][0]['corpus']['stdout'])
assert sha(expected)==pair['configurations'][0]['corpus']['stdout_sha256']
with actual.open('rb') as a,expected.open('rb') as b:
 while chunk:=a.read(1<<20): assert chunk==b.read(len(chunk))
 assert not b.read(1)
with actual.open() as f: assert sum(1 for _ in f)==88
assert sha(executable)==data['executable_sha256']
clean();data.update(complete=True,byte_identical_to_independently_checked_pair=True,
 settings_and_features_verified=True,independent_receipt=pair['independent_receipt'])
save();print(json.dumps({'complete':True,'receipt':str(OUT/'results.json'),'sha256':sha(OUT/'results.json')}),flush=True)

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

 with p.open('rb') as f: return hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
receipt=OUT/'results.json'
assert sha(receipt)=='5ef474e9404d7d6802eca641e7e0ae0ce69ce1ad56fb5827452919d38295fafd'
d=json.loads(receipt.read_bytes())
assert d['complete'] and d['byte_identical_to_independently_checked_pair'] and d['settings_and_features_verified']
driver=Path('/tmp/stele-lookup-scoped-measure.py')
assert sha(driver)==d['driver_sha256']
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',d['head']+'^{tree}'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()==d['tree']
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','f2dfd917baf00b8419dbf264c5f3cbdafa052d46',d['head'],'--',
 'crates','tests/negative-controls','Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','rust-toolchain.toml','.cargo'],cwd=ROOT)
for p,h in d['source_sha256'].items():
 assert hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',d['head']+':'+p],cwd=ROOT)).hexdigest()==h
manifest=json.loads((ROOT/'tests/negative-controls/fixtures/integer-linear/manifest.json').read_bytes())
assert sha(ROOT/'tests/negative-controls/fixtures/integer-linear/manifest.json')=='6636c4e707e8d4c1e7f95e2abd90ee9e289a7d065e3593430b2f9755f9722573'
assert all(sha(ROOT/p)==h for p,h in manifest['current_oracle_sources'].items())
old_path=ROOT/'bench/ledger/e0-10-lookup-corpus-profile.json'
assert sha(old_path)=='57785b529f6fe80eea948dfb020dd4f2bee234a950c5bb38acde92dc3f7c8f8a'
old=json.loads(old_path.read_bytes());pair=old['model_config']['measurement']
assert d['pair_receipt_sha256']==old['model_config']['measurement_receipt_sha256']
assert sha(Path(d['request_path']))==d['request_sha256']==pair['request_sha256']
artifacts={}
for phase in ('build','corpus'):
 r=d[phase];assert r['exit_code']==0
 for stream in ('stdout','stderr'):
  p=Path(r[stream]);assert p.parent==OUT and p.stat().st_size==r[stream+'_bytes'] and sha(p)==r[stream+'_sha256']
  artifacts[p.name]=dict(path=str(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size,sha256=sha(p))
assert not Path(d['corpus']['stderr']).read_bytes()
for runtime in d['runtime_artifacts']:
 p=runtime['profile'];assert p['opt_level']=='2' and p['debug_assertions'] and p['overflow_checks'] and not p['test']
assert {r['name']:r['features'] for r in d['runtime_artifacts']}=={
 r['name']:r['features'] for r in pair['configurations'][1]['runtime_artifacts']}
assert sha(Path(d['artifact']['executable']))==d['executable_sha256']
actual=Path(d['corpus']['stdout']);baseline=Path(pair['configurations'][0]['corpus']['stdout'])
assert sha(baseline)==pair['configurations'][0]['corpus']['stdout_sha256']
with actual.open('rb') as a,baseline.open('rb') as b:
 while chunk:=a.read(1<<20): assert chunk==b.read(len(chunk))
 assert not b.read(1)
with actual.open() as f:
 rows=[json.loads(line) for line in f]
counts=Counter(r['outcome'] if 'outcome' in r else ('accept' if r['decision']=='accept' else 'reject') for r in rows)
assert len(rows)==88 and counts=={'produced':10,'error':2,'accept':12,'reject':64}
plan=dict(task='E0-10',source_commit=d['head'],source_tree=d['tree'],
 source_sha256=d['source_sha256'],env=d['env'],request_sha256=d['request_sha256'],
 paired_ledger='e0-10-lookup-corpus-profile.json',paired_ledger_sha256=sha(old_path),
 scope='One additional cold build and complete native execution with the actual gate-scoped dev settings; immutable same-source requests and independently checked outputs from the screening pair. No historical proof campaign or independent expectation is regenerated.')

 model_config=dict(plan=plan,measurement=d,raw_artifacts=artifacts,receipt_sha256=sha(receipt),
  measurement_driver_source=driver.read_text(),verification_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),

  production_errors=2,accepted=12,rejected=64,unchanged_frozen_source_pins=38),
 proof_size_bytes=0,verifier_time_ns=dict(rust=0,python=0),controls=dict(total=0,passed=0,failed=0),
